title: Nine Loops: Subway
description: An anomaly-spotting loop game set in a cyberpunk subway. You walk the same corridor again and again, looking for anything that has changed while you search for a missing girl in a red hood. Free, in English or Japanese.
how_to_play: Walk down the corridor. If you notice anything unusual, turn back; if everything looks normal, keep going. Nine correct choices in a row gets you out, and a wrong one resets the count. Keyboard on desktop and touch on phones; the Controls menu lists the keys.
